issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to implement a helper named `_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(Hx, offset=0)`, but both the template and solution define `construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(Hx, offset=0)` (no leading underscore). This naming mismatch can cause students to implement the wrong function name and can break tests if they follow the problem statement.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single canonical name across the exercise. Easiest: update the problem statement to refer to `construct_zero_state_prep_circuit`. Alternatively, add an alias in template/solution: `_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit = construct_zero_state_prep_circuit` (and ensure tests match).

issues.description: `build_msd_circ` return-value documentation conflicts with the problem statement: the problem statement says the second returned list must be the measurement indices of the 15 destructive measurements of the tetrahedral-code qubits, but the template and solution docstrings describe the second list as measurements of the "distilled state". This can mislead students when indexing measurement results and performing error detection.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the `build_msd_circ` docstrings (template and solution) so the second return value is described as the measurement indices of the 15 tetrahedral-code qubits measured destructively in the X basis, in qubit order, matching the problem statement.
